english.title: Supply prohibited single-use plastic product in Wales
english.standardoffencewording:

(E)_[supplied a prohibited single-use plastic product, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT..), to **(..SPECIFY CONSUMER..), a consumer who was in Wales]_

english.legislation: Contrary to sections 5 and 6 of the Environmental Protection (Single-use Plastic Products) (Wales) Act 2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a body corporate / partnership / unincorporated association or person acting as a sole trader
supplied a prohibited single-use plastic product to a consumer who was in Wales or
offered on premises in Wales to supply a prohibited single-use plastic product to a consumer

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
